name: dsh-plugin-cicd
description: 发布台（Release Console）for DeepSeek Harness: a sidebar entry and a full main-panel page that show what each repository has built, what it has released, and whether the local checkout is ahead of the release — with buttons to trigger a build, cut a release, and publish a draft. Reuses the machine's authenticated gh CLI, so the plugin stores no credential of its own.

meta.title: 发布台
meta.description: GitHub Actions 的持续构建与发布面板：每个仓库的最近一次运行、已发布的 Release、本地是否领先于发布，以及一键构建 / 发布 / 公开草稿。复用本机已登录的 gh，不另存凭据。
